# AI Optimizer

AI Optimizer is a local-first desktop app that reduces repeated AI API waste by adding a caching and control layer in front of OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google Gemini workflows.

Best fit:
- repeat-heavy developer workflows
- scripts and automations
- agent workflows
- cron jobs and scheduled prompts
- local tools that send repeated API requests

Core idea:
- point existing workflows at a local proxy on localhost
- cache repeated requests
- track requests, cache hits, and provider behavior
- reduce repeated spend without rebuilding the whole stack

Key facts:
- local-first workflow
- localhost proxy setup
- installation and setup guide
- OpenAI support
- Anthropic support
- Google Gemini support for a narrower generateContent lane
- repeat-request caching
- cache-hit visibility
- best for repeated and recurring request patterns
